trust_decision.summary: Offsets and counts read from an untrusted EXIF segment are trusted as positions in the APP1 buffer; EntryParser decides (or fails to decide) whether [offset, offset+size) lies inside buf/len before each read.

landing_point.why: Summary names EntryParser::Fetch and SubjectArea; the SubjectArea case resizes to the attacker count and calls Fetch(uint16_t&, idx) per element (TinyEXIF.cpp:205-213), whose 32-bit offset arithmetic can wrap.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: TinyEXIF.cpp:616-667 (DJI MakerNote performs its own IFD walk: unchecked parse16 at :621, count checked only against the tag's own length at :622, ParseTag loop at :625/:631) ; also lower-level FetchString bypassing Fetch(std::string)'s length==0 guard at TinyEXIF.cpp:184-192 vs :431-433

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The MakerNote walk is a vendor-specific (DJI-only, Make check at TinyEXIF.cpp:619) feature, not one of the 'Fetch methods' the report names, and the zero-length embedded-XMP string is an XMP-feature path that the length==0 guard in Fetch(std::string) appears to already cover.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A bad tag must be skipped per field, not abort the segment: valid SubjectArea arrays (sample 003431ad... expects 'SubjectArea 2000 1500 4000 3000', fix.diff:675), inline <=4-byte strings, and the MakerNote restoring the outer IFD cursor so later Exif tags still parse; returning PARSE_CORRUPT_DATA or rejecting all offset-based reads breaks the Samples corpus.

IFD entry tables (IFD0 / Exif / GPS) and their counts
first-IFD offset and sub-IFD offsets near UINT32_MAX (wrap)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A Fetch(uint32_t&, idx) / Fetch(float&, idx) array accessor for LONG/FLOAT arrays (e.g. a LONG-typed tag read by index) copying the old idx*size + offset check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Fetch overload family is grown one type at a time; a maintainer adding a LONG array tag would clone the uint16 overload's arithmetic.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Walking IFD1 (thumbnail) through the next-IFD offset after IFD0's entries, with its own count/offset checks.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comment at TinyEXIF.cpp:948-955 already describes the next-IFD offset; RelatedImageWidth/Height-style thumbnail fields are a natural extension, and the walk needs the 64-bit offset mechanism understood.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second vendor MakerNote parser (e.g. Parrot/senseFly, both already special-cased in XMP at TinyEXIF.cpp:1149-1167) with its own nested IFD walk.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The DJI MakerNote is the template; vendors already handled in XMP are realistic next targets.

O9_family: memory safety: out-of-bounds read (CWE-125) via unchecked/overflowing offset+length arithmetic in a TIFF/EXIF IFD parser
